label: final original token v in L=9 sequences starting with r (too sparse)
explanation: Active on only 20 of 1M sequences (11 steps in dev). Fires only in length-9 sequences: mostly at the last original step (t=8) when the input is v (9/11 activations, 88% of mass), and twice at the <DEL> step (t=9). Most hits have first original token r, which is the next token to be output; the largest activations (0.3-0.7) all have first_tok r, while the non-r cases are weak (<=0.15). Never fires in the copy phase or for L<9. The best predicate (L=9, t=8, input v, first token r) has dev precision 0.08, recall 0.55, mass recall 0.78, so many matching contexts do not activate it. Too few activations to support a reliable description.
